sections.Aims and Fit of Module: Students gain a thorough understanding of the quantitative applications of interest and related functions. Students are required to understand how to price various financial instruments for different interest.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Classify and calculate all kind of rates of interest, find the future value and present value of a cash flow, and write the equation of value given a set of cash flows and an interest rate. B. Derive formulae for all kinds of annuities; classify the notation of annuities and formulas for the present value of financial derivatives C. Calculate the outstanding balance at any point in time D. Calculate a schedule of repayments under a loan and identify the interest and capital components in a given payment; Given the quantities, except one, in a sinking fund arrangement calculate the missing quantity; Calculate the present value of payments from a fixed interest security, bounds for the present value of a redeemable fixed interest security; E. Given the price, calculate the running yield and redemption yield from a fixed interest security F. Calculate the present value or real yield from an index-linked bond G. Calculate the price of, or yield from, a fixed interest security where the income tax and capital gains tax are implemented H. Calculate yield rate, the dollar-weighted and time weighted rate of return, the duration and convexity of a set of cash flows
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module is delivered through formal lectures and lab/practicals.
